name: SUPERB
description: SUPERB is a universal benchmark for speech processing that evaluates the performance of shared models across a wide range of speech tasks with minimal architecture changes. It focuses on self-supervised learning representations and includes a leaderboard and toolkit to promote research in speech representation learning.
reputation: A widely used and influential benchmark in speech representation learning, with a public leaderboard and toolkit that have seen broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on evaluating self-supervised learning speech representations with lightweight prediction heads; includes a leaderboard and benchmark toolkit.
